description: React component for a tour tip related to 'Burn-on-read' messages in Mattermost, including UI rendering, user interaction handling, and preferences management.

classes.name: BurnOnReadTourTip
classes.description: React functional component implementing a tour tip for burn-on-read messages, with state management, event handling, and UI rendering.

methods.name: BurnOnReadTourTip
methods.description: React component function that renders the tour tip UI and manages user interactions.

methods.name: markTourTipAsSeen
methods.description: Saves user preference indicating the tour tip has been seen.

methods.name: handleOpen
methods.description: Handles opening the tour tip when the pulsating dot is clicked.

methods.name: handleDismiss
methods.description: Handles dismissing the tour tip and marking it as seen.

methods.name: handleTryItOut
methods.description: Handles the 'Try it out' button click, marks the tip as seen, and triggers the provided callback.
